column1: # status-verb: the verb a worker puts at the front of a status line (state/<id>.status). Report-only (SM3): nothing here changes a classifier verdict.
# Rules: a verb a lane protocol uses outside the core set is an `extension` row, so it still surfaces as itself; a verb with no row is drift, found by tests/jg-machine-status.test.sh --drift.
# Rules: `blocked` names a real stop and says why (required field `reason`); a quiet checkpoint is never `blocked`, it is `working`.
# Kinds: `terminal` is a verb jg-classify answers is-terminal for; `extension` surfaces as itself; the rest are recognized and not captain-relevant.
# Not modelled: a `blocked` line that names a future `until` time is a declared wait to the classifier, like `paused`.
